pages.text: $(thing)Weeds$() come up on every field: fastest on warm, moist, fertile ground, held back by a mulch of residue and shaded out once a crop's canopy closes. They take light, water and nitrogen from the crop. Jade warns when a field is getting weedy.
Right-click a crop with a $(thing)hoe$() to weed it and its neighbours (a 3x3 patch). Tilling clears weeds too. Rye, oats, clover and alfalfa grown as a $(thing)cover crop$() smother them.
Sneak-right-click a growing crop with a hoe to cut it down green and work it into the soil as $(thing)green manure$(): fresh, nitrogen-rich residue, richest from a legume such as clover.
A $(thing)glass roof$() (glass blocks or panes up to eight blocks above the crop) makes a $(thing)greenhouse$(): no frost, warmer days and a longer season, but no rain gets in, so water it.
